title: Concise runbook: monorepo examples for Next.js, FastAPI, Go HTTP server, and CLI
creator: Ava Patel
description: Create a compact, opinionated set of example apps and cookbook snippets in a single monorepo demonstrating best-practice SDK usage for Next.js (edge + streaming SSR), FastAPI (async streaming + retry semantics), Go HTTP server (context cancellation + SSE), and a CLI (batching + resumable streaming). Focus on ergonomic streaming APIs, robust retry/backoff patterns, idempotency and token-refresh, and observability hooks that map to Redwood Console metrics. Deliverables: runnable templates, CI workflow, Docker/devcontainer, and short cookbooks for retry policies, KV prefix caching, and graceful degradation.
acceptance_criteria: Each template (Next.js, FastAPI, Go HTTP, CLI) runs locally via devcontainer and starts in under 20s
Streaming examples demonstrate an unbroken token stream for a 30s continuous response and support client-side cancelation within 200ms
Retry cookbook includes 3 patterns: simple exponential backoff, jittered backoff with circuit breaker, and idempotent request keys; each has a unit/integration test
Examples include instrumentation points (metrics events and tracing spans) that can be parsed by Redwood Console; docs show how to map 3 example metrics
Monorepo has a GitHub Actions workflow that lints, runs unit tests, and spins up an ephemeral runtime to smoke-test streaming endpoints
PR reviewed and merged with at least two engineering approvals and one Developer Experience (DX) review
Docs page (Confluence/Drive) with copy+paste snippets for each pattern and a short migration guide from earlier SDKs
tasks: Draft PRD and runbook with examples and trade-offs
Implement Next.js example: edge function + streaming SSR + client resume/cancel snippet
Implement FastAPI example: async generator streaming, server-sent events, backpressure handling
Implement Go HTTP server example: context cancellation, SSE, graceful shutdown, and connection-level retries
Implement CLI: interactive mode that streams tokens, batch mode for embeddings, and resume after transient failures
Write cookbook snippets: retry policies, idempotency keys, KV prefix caching, batching tips
Add observability hooks and sample dashboards mapping to Redwood Console metrics
Add Dockerfiles, devcontainer, and GitHub Actions CI for monorepo
Write automated integration tests for streaming end-to-end (node/python/go clients against local server)
Prepare PR, gather reviews, and iterate on feedback
